Effect: [Opponent's Turn][Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon digivolves into a level 5 or higher Digimon, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] All of your other Digimon with the same name as this Digimon get +2000 DP.
